verdict.rationale: The product exposes saved tasks to Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and Control Center, so a task can be started without opening the app and typing a goal. Recurring scheduling and external-event triggers are not documented; they would depend on iOS Shortcuts automations, which is a host-platform capability rather than the product's own. The Clock example (docs-2) is the agent setting an alarm as a task, not a scheduler for agent runs. Missing for 10: a native or documented recurring schedule for tasks, documented external-event triggers (e.g. an HTTP/webhook or automation trigger), and hands-on corroboration that Shortcuts-launched runs work unattended.

support.subject: As a power user, I can schedule a device task or trigger it from an external event, not only run it interactively

citations.quote: Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and Control Center can run saved tasks.
